title: Liquid AI d1 Matches GPT-6.1 Sol on 4 of 6 Tasks at 200x Lower Cost
summary:
The company's first decision model now supports images, text, or both as inputs to automate industrial workloads such as inspecting circuit boards. Liquid AI tested d1 against OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol and Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 across six real applications, including filtering support tickets, where d1 matched or beat GPT-6.1 Sol in four instances. The model reduces costs by 19x to 200x compared to its competitors and produces text decisions in 200 to 300 ms using a single forward pass without generating tokens.

The addition of vision allows the model to perform optical character recognition without prompt engineering and can improve performance for text-only tasks, according to a technical review. The model's architecture is designed to remain computationally efficient and inexpensive even when processing complex visual inputs for yes/no, choice, or score questions.
